name: science-literature
description: Keyless, read-only literature lookups for scientific work: search PubMed and fetch abstracts through NCBI E-utilities, search Europe PMC (journal articles and preprints) with cursor paging, and resolve a DOI through Crossref. Each record carries PMID, PMCID and DOI where known, title, journal, year, publication types, whether it is a preprint, and whether the provider's data flags it as retracted (retracted, not_flagged or unknown). Every result includes retrieval provenance (provider, request URL, UTC time, SHA-256 of the raw response) that drops straight into a science-evidence bundle. Requests go only to eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, www.ebi.ac.uk and api.crossref.org over HTTPS, with no caller-supplied URLs, no retries and at most 100 records per call. A record that resolves is not evidence that it supports a claim.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: scilit.pubmed_search
tools.description: Search PubMed through NCBI E-utilities (esearch, then esummary for the hits) and return citation records: PMID, PMCID, DOI, title, journal, year, publication types, preprint and retraction flags. Optional publication-date range (min_date and max_date together, YYYY, YYYY/MM or YYYY/MM/DD). Abstracts come from scilit.pubmed_abstracts. NCBI allows about 3 requests per second without a key; make one call at a time.

query.description: PubMed query, with field tags if needed, for example malaria vaccine[tiab] (at most 1,000 characters)

min_date.description: Earliest publication date, YYYY, YYYY/MM or YYYY/MM/DD (requires max_date)

max_date.description: Latest publication date in the same format (requires min_date)

tools.name: scilit.pubmed_abstracts
tools.description: Fetch PubMed abstracts and citation details for up to 100 PMIDs through E-utilities efetch. Labelled abstract sections are kept with their labels. Use the text to quote passages into an evidence bundle; PubMed holds abstracts, not full text.

tools.name: scilit.europepmc_search
tools.description: Search Europe PMC (journal articles, preprints and more) and return citation records with publication types, preprint and retraction flags, and licence where given. Page with the returned next_cursor. Europe PMC permits automated bulk download of its open-access subset only; use this for targeted searches.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page; omit for the first page

tools.name: scilit.crossref_work
tools.description: Resolve one DOI through the Crossref REST API: title, container (journal), year, work type, preprint flag, licence and retraction updates where Crossref records them. A resolving DOI shows the work exists; it does not show the work supports a claim.

doi.description: A bare DOI such as 10.1000/xyz123 (not a URL)
